_construction_note: Authored 2026-08-08, Phase 5 tranche 14 (packet L: Ironclad Facilities Management VENDOR-6027), after V6 freeze. Genuinely tricky combined case: an original term SUPERSEDED by an amendment, but the amendment itself is LATER REVOKED with no reinstatement -- so nothing is CURRENT for this predicate at all. Tests what current_ones-empty fallback behavior actually produces when multiple non-current candidates exist (original SUPERSEDED, amendment REVOKED), not just the single-non-current-document case already covered by B9-001.

documents.content: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT CT-2026-6027. Between ExergyNet Corp and Ironclad Facilities Management (VENDOR-6027). Service tier: STANDARD.
AMENDMENT AM-2026-6027-A to CT-2026-6027. Service tier upgraded from STANDARD to PREMIUM, effective 2026-04-01.

NOTICE OF REVOCATION: Amendment AM-2026-6027-A (PREMIUM service tier upgrade) is REVOKED effective 2026-06-01, following a billing dispute. No successor amendment has been issued as of the benchmark reference date -- service tier status is presently unresolved pending renegotiation.
